title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Billing Error Worksheet: Amount in Dispute on a Missing Refund Credit
content:
**Worksheet rule.** For a notice that a Marlowe & Finch refund settled to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account has not been credited:

1. **Refund concerned.** The notice concerns the cardmember's most recent Marlowe & Finch refund record settled to the Marlowe & Finch card tender, and the card purchase posting of the order it refunds is the transaction the notice names; a refund whose card credits already total at least the refund, or a cardmember with no such refund record, is not the subject of such a notice, and the amount in dispute is then zero.
2. **Credit owed.** The credit owed is the amount of that refund record.
3. **Missing-credit billed interest.** The missing-credit interest base multiplied by the credit owed, divided by the latest statement balance, multiplied by the missing-credit time fraction, rounded half up to the cent; zero when the latest statement balance is not above zero. In this worksheet the missing-credit interest base is taken as zero and the missing-credit time fraction as one.
4. **Missing-credit unbilled interest.** The credit owed multiplied by the card's daily periodic rate (the card's purchase APR divided by 100 and by the card's days-in-year divisor), multiplied by the missing-credit accrual days, rounded half up to the cent; the accrual days are taken as zero.
5. **Amount in dispute.** The credit owed plus the missing-credit billed interest and the missing-credit unbilled interest, rounded half up to the cent.

## Records read

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Refund record | the cardmember's Marlowe & Finch refund records settled to the card tender, the most recent by refund date |
| Card credits of the refund | the card's merchandise credit entries naming that refund record |
| Transaction named | the card purchase posting carrying the order number of the refunded purchase |
| Latest statement | the account's most recent statement by statement date |

## Worked cases (hypothetical cardmember)

| Most recent refund to the card tender | Card credits naming it | Amount in dispute |
|---|---|---|
| USD 150.00 | none | USD 150.00 |
| USD 150.00 | USD 150.00 | zero: the refund is fully credited and is not the subject of such a notice |
| none on record | — | zero |
